description: Publish a changelog entry (status → published). It appears on the public /changelog timeline + RSS/Atom feeds and, on the first publish, fires the changelog.published notification to subscribers. Reversible (no dry_run gate). Pass the entry UUID from changelog_list.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

published_at.description: Release date to stamp instead of now (ISO-8601; naive read as UTC). Wins over any date already on the entry. Use it when publishing a HISTORICAL entry so the date-ordered timeline reads in true release order.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: changelog_publish
